mapper.select: SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, employee_num AS employeeNum, employee_password AS password FROM employee WHERE employee_num = #{employeeNum}
SELECT r.role_code FROM employee_role er JOIN role r ON er.role_id = r.role_id WHERE er.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT av.view_id AS viewId, av.view_code AS viewCode, av.view_name AS viewName, av.view_desc AS viewDesc FROM role_view rv JOIN app_view av ON rv.view_id = av.view_id WHERE rv.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY av.view_id ASC
